chapter: Trent's band: Arkansas, Dallas and the Adolphus
title: Trent's wealthy Fort Smith family and the band they bankrolled
summary: Trent, from a family owning rows of rent houses, is more business-minded than Cook and keeps the band together near Little Rock.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: WELL NOW TRIPP OBVIOUSLY TRAVELS A MORE BUSINESS KIND OF GUY. HE WAS MORE BUSINESS-MINDED KIND OF A GUY THEN SOMEONE LIKE COOK WOULD HAVE BEEN?
COOK WAS AN OLDER GUY, BUT COOK WASN'T TOO RESPONSIBLE WAS HE?
No. Cook was much older, but he didn't have very much business . Then Tripp was very wealthy too you know.
Well, he , at one time they had 100 rent houses. His family had rows of houses called Trent's Row.

Fort Smith, right. Well after we played Stem Beach that summer I had to still go back to school. Yeah and Trent brought the band to Little Rock and stayed around Little Rock so that I could be with the band. I appreciated it very much.
HE COULD AFFORD TO STAY AROUND THERE EVEN THOUGH THERE WASN'T THAT MUCH WORK?
HIS FAMILY HAD THE MONEY. THEY INDULGED HIM TO KEEP HIS THING TOGETHER.
They gave him anything he wanted.
